instruction:
Farm Shop and Greenhouse Link Drawing Set and Room Schedule

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited room schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey entity and exactly 6 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 24 IfcWall entities, at least 2 IfcSlab entities, and at least 2 IfcRoof entities.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: SHOP, PREP, STORE, OFFICE, WC, GREENHOUSE.
7. Every listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [16.0, 8.0, 3.92].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: RoomNumber, RoomName, Area.
10. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 6 data rows in this order: F01 SHOP 25.0, F02 PREP 9.0, F03 STORE 6.0, F04 OFFICE 9.0, F05 WC 4.0, F06 GREENHOUSE 48.0, with numeric values matching within tolerance +/-0.10.
11. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf has exactly 2 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A101, A201, FLOOR PLAN, SECTION, FARM SHOP AND GREENHOUSE LINK, SHOP, GREENHOUSE, PREP.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
